People: Théophile Gautier (author, Wikidata Q183713), died 1872; Lafcadio Hearn (translator, Wikidata Q313638), died 1904. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Gautier, Théophile, 1811-1872; Hearn, Lafcadio, 1850-1904 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Stories by Foreign Authors, C. Scribner's Sons, 1898, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/storiesbyforeig06unkngoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 72%, 87%, 88% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Lafcadio Hearn, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
